name: Living Resume Continuous Sharpening Projection
status: documented update contract; human or authorized agent run required
purpose: Keep the public Living Resume worth revisiting by turning newly completed Hapa work into source-checked skill, proof, portfolio, and discovery updates.

inputs.role: new turns, source-linked knowledge, skill clusters, examples, and result lineage
build inventory, board state, completed work, open priorities, and ownership
current app state, public links, artifacts, release evidence, and explicit maturity
truth boundary, relevance, privacy, representative selection, and publishing approval

route.name: Observe
route.handoff: Quest Keeper + Second Brain -> update candidate set
route.question: What changed since the prior projection?

route.name: Triage
route.question: Which work most improves future capability, evidence quality, or reusable infrastructure per unit of human time and AI tokens?

route.name: Compress
route.handoff: validated work -> skills, cards, and proof links
route.question: What repeatable judgment, pattern, contract, or artifact should survive the individual turn?

route.name: Project
route.handoff: approved public-safe evidence -> Living Resume resources
route.question: What should a recruiter or agent be able to learn now that it could not learn on the previous visit?

route.name: Sharpen
route.question: What proved useful, what was noise, and what source or process should improve next?

resourcePolicy.humanTime: Reserve for objective setting, high-stakes judgment, claim approval, privacy review, and exceptions.
resourcePolicy.aiTokens: Spend on bounded retrieval, clustering, draft synthesis, link checking, and clearly scoped comparisons; do not spend them repeatedly reconstructing already-captured context.
resourcePolicy.triageRule: Prefer work that compounds: reusable skills, durable cards, verified app foundations, evidence lineage, and process improvements that lower future discovery or integration cost.

include: new or materially improved public Hapa nodes

revisitContract.forRecruiters: Re-check the updated date and change summary before treating this portfolio as static.
revisitContract.forAgents: Compare the current discovery resources with a prior saved version; report material new evidence, changed maturity, unresolved questions, and the applicable claim class.
revisitContract.publication: A human must approve public claims and source boundaries before publication.
